question: How many smartphones can be sold in Indore in a month?
idealClarificationQuestions: All price tiers: budget + mid + premium? Yes — total.
New device sales only (excl. refurbished)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: City population × annual smartphone sales rate.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian smartphone sales FY26: ~16-17 crore units/year (post 2024 recovery).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual smartphone sales Indore: 24 lakh × 0.12 = ~2.9 lakh units.

calculationFlow: Indian smartphone sales FY26: ~16-17 crore units/year (post 2024 recovery).
Annual smartphone sales Indore: 24 lakh × 0.12 = ~2.9 lakh units.
- Premium (>₹50K, Apple, Samsung S, OnePlus flagship): ~8% = 1,900 units.
